title: Cache stampede: one hot key expires and every request goes to the database
caption: Fix: let one request rebuild the value while the others wait or get the slightly old copy.

messages.label: GET home:top (TTL just expired)
messages.note: A key read 10 000 times a second has just expired.

messages.label: GET home:top
messages.note: In the ~50 ms it takes to rebuild, about 500 more requests miss too.

messages.label: ~500 identical queries
messages.note: Without protection they all query the database at once, and it falls over exactly when traffic peaks.

messages.label: SET lock:home:top NX PX 5000
messages.note: Fix: the first miss takes a short lock and is the only one to rebuild.

messages.label: SET home:top EX 300±30
messages.note: Store the fresh value with a jittered TTL so hot keys don't all expire together.

messages.label: fresh value (others waited or got stale)
